questions.stem: Respiratory system disorders commonly present with cough. Following statements are true regarding the symptom EXCEPT

options.label: A
options.text: Non-significant expectoration is common in cases of Upper respiratory tract infection

options.label: B
options.text: Sputum production more than 100ml/day is bronchorrhea

options.label: D
options.text: Significant expectoration is common in Pleural effusion
